description: Recovered fx2-cmix payload with the corrected ByteMixer multi-input scale, dictionary-pretrain sidecar-byte sync, semantic MediaWiki direct/match contexts, and three learned semantic sidecar byte-distribution models.

fixes: ByteMixer multi-input scaling uses float division
Sidecar byte models advance during dictionary pretraining
build.packaging: Minified Python xz bootstrap with check-free cmix.xz and english.dic.xz payloads.

hypothesis: The archive-positive older byte-split family may become useful when its recomputable semantic state is compiled into recovered fx2-cmix rather than shipped as a large sidecar wrapper. This candidate evaluates the corrected combined native path after isolating byte-only and direct/match-only variants.
